findings.quote: If the Issuer has insufficient Issuer Available Funds to repay the Senior Notes in full
findings.exception: unless payment of such amounts is being improperly withheld or refused
findings.explanation: Condition8.1.3 cancels unpaid amounts on insufficient funds, subject to improper-withholding exception.
findings.criterion: Retain as unpaid principal loss or unresolved meaning, not ordinary post-payment cancellation.

findings.explanation: Condition9.2.3 extinguishes unpaid claims after a certificate and notice; this is not cancellation after payment.
findings.criterion: Retain as unpaid principal loss or unresolved meaning, not ordinary post-payment cancellation.

findings.explanation: Condition7(b) preserves unpaid claims until the later CancellationDate, with a misconduct exception.
